description: This Java source file defines Cucumber step definitions ('steps') for database validation scenarios in an automation testing framework for the OrangeHRM project. It includes steps for verifying database connection, table existence, record presence/absence, data insertion/updating/deletion, executing arbitrary queries, asserting row counts and query results, and cleanup operations. The file interacts with the database via utility classes and integrates with the test scenario lifecycle, providing detailed logging and assertions.

classes.name: DatabaseValidationSteps
classes.description: A class providing Cucumber step definitions for database-related validation actions in test scenarios for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: theDatabaseConnectionIsConfiguredForTheCurrentEnvironment
methods.description: Verifies that the database connection is configured and accessible; skips scenario if not.

methods.name: theTableExistsInTheDatabase
methods.description: Checks if a specified table exists in the database.

methods.name: aRecordExistsInTableWhereColumnEqualsValue
methods.description: Verifies that a record with specific column value exists.

methods.name: noRecordExistsInTableWhereColumnEqualsValue
methods.description: Ensures that no record with specific column value exists, deleting pre-existing ones if necessary.

methods.name: iInsertARecordIntoTableWithColumnValue
methods.description: Inserts a record with a single column value pair.

methods.name: iInsertARecordIntoTableWithValues
methods.description: Inserts a record with multiple column-value pairs parsed from a string.

methods.name: iUpdateTableSetColumnWhereCondition
methods.description: Updates a specific column in a table where a condition matches.

methods.name: iUpdateTableSetValuesWhereCondition
methods.description: Updates multiple columns in a table based on a condition.

methods.name: iDeleteFromTableWhereCondition
methods.description: Deletes a record matching a condition in a table.

methods.name: iExecuteTheQuery
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and stores the results.

methods.name: iExecuteTheQueryWithParameter
methods.description: Executes a parameterized query and stores the results.

methods.name: theOperationShouldAffectNRows
methods.description: Asserts that the last DML operation affected a specific number of rows.

methods.name: aRecordShouldExistInTableWhereColumnEquals
methods.description: Asserts the existence of a specific record.

methods.name: noRecordShouldExistInTableWhereColumnEquals
methods.description: Asserts that no matching record exists.

methods.name: theValueOfColumnInTableShouldBe
methods.description: Asserts a specific column's value matches expected.

methods.name: theCountOfRecordsShouldBe
methods.description: Asserts the number of records matching a condition.

methods.name: theQueryResultShouldContainNRows
methods.description: Asserts the number of rows returned by last query.

methods.name: theQueryResultShouldNotBeEmpty
methods.description: Checks that last query results are non-empty.

methods.name: theQueryResultShouldBeEmpty
methods.description: Verifies last query results are empty.

methods.name: theDatabaseShouldBeAccessible
methods.description: Verifies database connectivity.

methods.name: iCleanUpTheRecordInTableWhereColumnEquals
methods.description: Deletes a specific test record to restore clean state.
